q1_issues.issue: Location is the event oblique, but sk_group_1 is a group witness (a sum individual, not an eventuality); the instruction set forbids Location on an entity and reserves the static LocatedIn head for where a thing is.

q2_gaps: An existential-there generic ("there are a lot of N in P") that states a place's characteristic frequency rather than one specific set — every encoding offered asserts one concrete group of earthquakes located in Japan.
notes: "a lot of" is correctly routed to CardinalityPhrase rather than to generic strength, since here the phrase counts things, and Japan receives its required Name atom.
